key_doctrine.rule: Prosecution must disclose material favorable evidence to the defense
key_doctrine.materiality_standard: Reasonable probability of different outcome — probability sufficient to undermine confidence in verdict

citizen_relevance: Case #04-23-01959 and all criminal proceedings. Brady requires disclosure of any evidence favorable to the steward — including the discrepancy between the purported OPD report and OPD's actual records, government witness credibility evidence, and any evidence of coordination among state actors. Post-SB 1421 (§832.7), sustained officer misconduct findings are both PRA-accessible and Brady material.
